summary: acer aspire 7 gaming has performance issues due to thermal throttling and driver-related problems with the Nvidia graphics driver.
detected_fault: Thermal throttling and driver-related issues, specifically with the Nvidia graphics driver.
suggested_solution: Upgrade RAM to DDR4 16GB X 1, update BIOS and Firmware from Acer website, use DDU to clean uninstall drivers and install the latest VGA NVIDIA Driver.
